steps.text: Talk to the Injured Tortugan on the small island north-west of The Great Conch to start the quest.
Shake a nearby palm for a palm leaf.
Pick up the palm leaf from the ground
Pick up seaweed from the shore.
Use the seaweed on the palm leaf to create makeshift bandages.
Talk to the Injured Tortugan and give her the makeshift bandages.
Help the Injured Tortugan with her wounds.
Talk to the Injured Tortugan again.
Board your boat with Floopa.
Sail to the docks at the southern edge of The Great Conch with Floopa.
Talk to Elder Korel at the docks of The Great Conch.
Head into The Summer Shore to the north and talk to Elder Raley in the south-east building.
Talk to Elder Raley after completing the town repairs.
Inspect the monument in the middle of town to pick up the Gryphon's trail.
Follow the Gryphon tracks west of town and inspect the red plant.
Follow the Gryphon tracks north and inspect the rockslide.
Follow the Gryphon tracks north up the hill and inspect the plant on the east side.
Follow the Gryphon tracks east and inspect the plant to reveal the final set of tracks.
Follow the Gryphon tracks east and unblock the cave entrance.
Enter the Gryphon's cave, prepared for a fight.
Defeat the Gryphon. It hits with melee, and does a special attack if your worn weight is less than 40kg.
Return to Elder Raley with news about the Gryphon's defeat.
Return to Elder Raley with news about the Gryphon's defeat.
Get a Tortugan shield from Elder Blunn.
Sail to Little Pearl island, south-east of The Great Conch, to confront the Shellbane gryphon.
Sail to Little Pearl island, south-east of The Great Conch, to confront the Shellbane gryphon.

Defeat the Shellbane gryphon. Have your worn weight be at least 40kg to avoid some damage. Protect from ranged if you're ranging it, and protect from melee when in melee range. Avoid tornadoes. Move when it spits a slow blob at you.
Talk to Elder Korel after defeating the Shellbane gryphon.
Return to Elder Raley at The Great Conch to complete the quest.
Return to Elder Raley at The Great Conch to complete the quest.
Return to Elder Raley at The Great Conch to complete the quest.
Gather materials and repair the objects around the town. Clear your inventory until you have 22 slots free for the material to speed up repairing.
